info.name: CRP API
info.description: Postman collection for the Complaint Resolution Portal API. Feature-based modular architecture with RBAC.

item.name: Regional Offices
item.description: Unified /regional-offices endpoints. POST/PATCH/DELETE: ADMIN only. GET: ADMIN, REGIONAL_OFFICE (filtered by role).

item.name: Branches
item.description: Unified /branches endpoints. POST/PATCH/DELETE: ADMIN only. GET: ADMIN, REGIONAL_OFFICE, BRANCH (filtered by role).

item.name: Users
item.description: Unified /users endpoints. POST/PATCH/DELETE: ADMIN only. GET all: ADMIN, REGIONAL_OFFICE (filtered by role). GET by ID: ADMIN, REGIONAL_OFFICE, BRANCH.

item.name: Tickets
item.description: Unified /tickets endpoints. POST: BRANCH only. GET all: all roles (filtered by role in service). Resolve: RO, HEAD_OFFICE. Escalate: RO only.

item.name: Admin
item.description: Admin-exclusive endpoints. Only GET /admin/analytics remains — all shared CRUD moved to feature modules.
